name: s85-stop-gate-no-python-reverifies-stale-file
setup_commands: mkdir -p minbin && for t in bash sh git dirname basename tr date mkdir tail head sed grep cat env rm mv cp perl sleep cksum; do p=$(command -v "$t") && ln -sf "$p" "minbin/$t"; done; true
notes: No python3: a.sh passes, then changes without an Edit. Its log line no longer matches the content (cksum stamp), so stop re-runs the check instead of trusting the old pass — broken blocks, fixed is allowed.
